title: 第27章折磨唐三、戴沐白，偶遇女神孟依然
content_zh:
第27章折磨唐三、戴沐白，偶遇女神孟依然-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》

上一章

存书签

下一章

叶寒从记事起，就不再相信命运，只相信自己。

只有这样，才能让自己在这个残酷的世界中生存下去。

正是这个信念，让他在残酷的杀手训练营活了下来，最终成为一名令整个世界都为之胆颤的国际顶级杀手。

如今，他来到了斗罗大陆，获得强大的家族系统，就更不能向天臣服。

他要借助系统的力量，打破天地规则，成为不受天道束缚的超脱者。

他也相信，创建天门能让他的家族系统变得更加完善，更加强大。

此时此刻，他的身上释放出一股永不服输的帝皇之势，以及能让人心生极度信任的亲和感，让大家情绪与他产生了共鸣。

“好一个人定胜天，我命由我不由天！”

“叶寒大哥，我们就叫天门，这个名字太好了！”

朱竹清被叶寒创建天门的理念所感染。

她现在就是想打破家族的规则，掌控自己的命运。

“天门！”

“天门！”

小舞、宁荣荣、奥斯卡、马红俊四人纷纷大声呼喊，宣告一个宗门的成立。

唐三和戴沐白在这种氛围下，都差点喊了出来。

但俩人一想到叶寒刚才对他们残忍做法，就很气愤，喊不出来。

有朝一日，他们一定找机会报仇。

【叮！小舞主动提出创建宗门，为家族做出贡献，贡献值10%，宿主和小舞皆提升1倍的修行速度和体魄加成。】

【叮！奥斯卡和马红俊同意小舞创建宗门意见，为家族做出贡献，贡献值5%，宿主和奥斯卡、马红俊皆提升50%的修行速度和体魄加成。】

【叮！朱竹清同意小舞创建宗门意见，为家族做出贡献，贡献值25%，宿主和小舞皆提升2.5倍修行速度和体魄加成。】

【注：所有人的修行速度加成不叠加，以最高为准，例如朱竹清的修行速度加成最高，为2.5倍，宿主最多增加2.5倍修行速度，不会额外叠加，但体魄可以累计叠加，无上限。】

叶寒相继收到系统的提示，体魄得到了明显的提升。

此时，叶寒就算仅依靠肉身力量，也能暴揍魂王以下所有人。

“唐三，戴沐白，你们什么意思？”

“你们不喊话，是不想加入天门，要跟老大做对吗？”

宁荣荣见戴沐白和唐三都不喊话，厉声谴责他们的行为。

“没，没有，我们愿意加入天门。”

戴沐白与唐三相互对视了一眼，赶紧表示态度。

【叮！宁荣荣劝阻戴沐白和唐三加入天门，为家族做出贡献，贡献值5%，宿主和宁荣荣皆提升50%的倍修行速度和体魄加成。】

“鉴于唐三和戴沐白态度不明确，不配合，从今天起，他们在大家的面前就是身份最低微的小弟，以后你们有什么事情，可以安排他们去执行。”

“若是他们不从，就相当于违背我的命令，必将严惩。”

叶寒收到系统提示，见戴沐白和唐三还不乐意，当即宣布两人在史莱克学院和天门中的地位。

他就不信了，还不能将两人的‘野性’降服。

“凭什么！”

唐三听到叶寒的决定，怒声爆吼。

叶寒一人实力强，操控他就算了，凭什么其他人也能。

他对这个决定表示不服。

“呵呵，就凭我是老大，一切都要听我的。”

“否则，这就是下场！”

叶寒见唐三还敢顶嘴，直接一巴掌扇了过去。

响亮的巴掌声响起。

唐三刚刚消肿的小脸，又肿了起来。

“你......”

唐三遭受这一巴掌，怒不可遏，想要开口反驳，却看到叶寒的耳光又扇了过来。

唐三哪儿敢站在原地不动，施展鬼影迷踪闪避。

但叶寒早就预判了他的动作，耳光还是扇在他的脸上。

这下子，唐三老实了。

他知道，跟叶寒的实力差距太大，想反抗，完全没用。

“老大说得对，谁让我们的态度不好。”

“小三，还不赶紧向老大道歉。”

戴沐白也看出叶寒在针对他们，但他也没办法，只能认怂，劝导唐三妥协。

Chapter 27 Torturing Tang San and Dai Mubai, encountering the goddess Meng Yiran - "Douluo V: Binding Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning, creating a god-level family"

Ever since Ye Han could remember, he no longer believed in fate, only believed in himself.

Only in this way can you survive in this cruel world.

It was this belief that allowed him to survive the brutal killer training camp, and eventually became a top international killer who made the whole world tremble.

Now that he has come to Douluo Continent and gained a powerful family system, he cannot surrender to the sky.

He wants to use the power of the system to break the rules of heaven and earth and become a transcendent person who is not bound by the laws of heaven.

He also believed that creating Tianmen would make his family system more complete and stronger.

At this moment, he exuded an imperial power that would never admit defeat, as well as a sense of intimacy that could make people feel extremely trusting, making everyone's emotions resonate with him.

"One person can conquer the sky, my fate is up to me and not up to the sky!"

"Brother Ye Han, let's call him Tianmen. This name is great!"

Zhu Zhuqing was infected by Ye Han's idea of establishing Tianmen.

She now just wants to break the family's rules and control her own destiny.

"Tianmen!"

"Tianmen!"

Xiao Wu, Ning Rongrong, Oscar, and Ma Hongjun all shouted loudly, announcing the establishment of a sect.

Tang San and Dai Mubai almost shouted in this atmosphere.

But when the two of them thought about Ye Han's cruel behavior to them just now, they became very angry and couldn't cry out.

One day, they will definitely find an opportunity to take revenge.

【bite!Xiao Wu took the initiative to create a sect and contribute to the family. The contribution value was 10%, and both the host and Xiao Wu doubled their cultivation speed and physical bonus.】

[Ding!Oscar and Ma Hongjun agree with Xiao Wu's opinion on establishing a sect and contribute to the family, with a contribution value of 5%. The host, Oscar and Ma Hongjun both increase their training speed and physical bonus by 50%.】

[Ding!Zhu Zhuqing agrees with Xiao Wu's opinion on establishing a sect and contributes to the family. The contribution value is 25%. Both the host and Xiao Wu increase their cultivation speed and physical strength by 2.5 times.】

[Note: Everyone's practice speed bonus does not stack, whichever is the highest. For example, Zhu Zhuqing's practice speed bonus is the highest, 2.5 times. The host's practice speed can be increased by up to 2.5 times. There will be no additional superposition, but the body can be cumulatively superimposed without an upper limit.】

Ye Han received notifications from the system one after another, and his physical condition improved significantly.

At this time, Ye Han could beat everyone below the Soul King even if he only relied on his physical strength.

"Tang San, Dai Mubai, what do you mean?"

"You don't shout because you don't want to join Tianmen and you want to go against the boss?"

When Ning Rongrong saw that Dai Mubai and Tang San didn't speak out, she sternly condemned their behavior.

"No, no, we are willing to join Tianmen."

Dai Mubai and Tang San looked at each other and quickly expressed their attitudes.

【bite!Ning Rongrong persuaded Dai Mubai and Tang San to join Tianmen and contribute to the family. The contribution value was 5%. Both the host and Ning Rongrong increased their cultivation speed and physical bonus by 50%.】

"In view of Tang San and Dai Mubai's unclear attitude and lack of cooperation, from today on, they will be the lowest-status juniors in front of everyone. If you have anything to do in the future, you can arrange for them to execute it."

"If they disobey, it will be equivalent to disobeying my order and will be severely punished."

Ye Han received the system prompt and saw that Dai Mubai and Tang San were not happy, so he immediately announced their status in Shrek Academy and Tianmen.

He didn't believe it, and he still couldn't subdue the "wildness" of the two of them.

"Why!"

When Tang San heard Ye Han's decision, he roared angrily.

Ye Han is very powerful, so even if he can control him, why can anyone else do it?

He expressed dissatisfaction with the decision.

"Haha, just because I am the boss, you have to listen to me in everything."

"Otherwise, this is what will happen!"

Seeing that Tang San still dared to talk back, Ye Han slapped him.

There was a loud slap.

Tang San's little face, which had just subsided, became swollen again.

"You..."

Tang San was furious after receiving this slap, and wanted to retort, but saw Ye Han slap him again.

How dare Tang San stand still and use Ghost Shadow to dodge.

But Ye Han had already predicted his actions and slapped him on the face anyway.

Now, Tang San was honest.

He knew that there was a huge gap in strength between him and Ye Han, and it was completely useless to resist.

"Boss is right, who made us have a bad attitude?"

"Xiaosan, why don't you apologize to the boss quickly?"

Dai Mubai also saw that Ye Han was targeting them, but he had no choice but to give in and persuade Tang San to compromise.
